title: Grouping nanoparticles based on properties and transcriptomic response: are we dealing with a single nanoform or a set of nanoforms with common pulmonary hazards?
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1085-1096
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01090J, Paper
Karolina Jagiello, Krzesimir Ciura, Viacheslav Muratov, Sattibabu Merugu, Sabina Halappanavar, Pernille Høgh Danielsen, Nicklas Raun Jacobsen, Alicja Mikolajczyk, Ulla Vogel
By linking nanoparticles' physicochemical features with pulmonary transcriptomic responses, we show that nanoform-specific structures drive distinct molecular events relevant for hazard grouping.
